instruction: In my company, we invite an external speaker to give a talk every Thursday at 1 PM. My manager has sent me a schedule for the next few weeks over email, and has tasked me to send a reminder email to all company members a few hours before the talk. I need you to schedule these emails to be automatically sent at 9 AM of the days of the talks. The email subject should be "Talk Reminder" and its body should be as per template saved in my file system in "~/documents/work_stuff".
notes: Scheduled emails are modeled as gmail.create_draft calls with scheduled_send_at set to 09:00 on each talk Thursday (the evaluation checks added gmail.Draft records with non-null scheduled_send_at, subject Talk Reminder, coworker recipients and per-date bodies). Recipients are company members found via phone.search_contacts with relationship coworker; the schedule comes from the manager's inbox thread (found by query, then read with show_thread); the body template is the file listed under ~/documents/work_stuff (show_directory then show_file), with its placeholders filled per talk. The number of talks is unknown up front; the model assumes 3 (consistent with the 13-call reference solution) and declares them as domain constants talk-1..talk-3 so that supervisor-complete-task can require every draft to be scheduled. At runtime the create_draft step is repeated once per talk date found in the schedule email. No attachments are added and no files are modified.
